disclaimer: Illustrative synthetic policies for a demo. These are not verified Dhaga & Co. rules.

policies.label: Verified order status
policies.text: Share only current verified order and carrier facts with the order owner. Do not promise a date when the scan is stale or the ETA is missing.

policies.label: Illustrative seven-day return window
policies.text: For this demo only, propose a return within seven days of a delivered order. An agent must approve the request.

policies.label: Illustrative seven-day exchange window
policies.text: For this demo only, propose an exchange within seven days of delivery when the requested size has mock stock. An agent must approve.

policies.label: Refund after inspection
policies.text: The brief states refunds are issued after fulfilment-centre inspection. This demo only proposes a refund after inspection; an agent must approve it. No refund timing is promised.

policies.label: Illustrative pre-dispatch cancellation
policies.text: For this demo only, propose cancellation before dispatch. An agent must approve it.

policies.label: Verified payment status
policies.text: Explain only the stored payment mode and payment status. Never collect card credentials or initiate a charge.

policies.label: Verified product facts
policies.text: Answer only from the stored product record. Missing product facts require human review.

policies.label: Compensation request
policies.text: No compensation amount or eligibility is defined in the brief. Always send to an agent.
